does: Copies one roll stream (0x78 bytes) field by field into another: its combat participants, cast and player names, combat guid, type, frame, both debts, seed and count.

evidence.says: GK.Memory.Watch on the Generic stream's NumRolls (component and roll manager, stream+0x70): hits at +0x105DBBD every frame with the value unchanged, from SystemUpdate<esv::roll::stream::UpdateSystem> (+0x238ABC3) and from the SaveSystem's work (+0x342DDF9); the offsets it copies agree with Script Extender's Stream and PRNGState
A write watch on a stream's count in the roll manager is hit at +0x105DBBD inside this function every frame, the value unchanged
A count-only probe on it shows every call coming from +0x105D985 inside the copy of an array of streams
The name is ours: the Toolkit exports no function of this name and the macOS build's symbols hold none; it stands in the namespace of the functions that call it.
